tutorial: FreeCAD wiki FEM_CalculiX_Cantilever_3D.md, whose model is FreeCAD's own example femexamples/ccx_cantilever_faceload.py (on ccx_cantilever_base_solid.py): an 8000 x 1000 x 1000 mm box, CalculiX-Steel (210000 MPa, 0.30), fixed on Face1 (x = 0), 9 MN on Face2 (x = 8000) along -z
reference: FreeCAD 1.1 source: src/Mod/Fem/femexamples/ccx_cantilever_faceload.py and ccx_cantilever_base_solid.py; the input deck it writes is src/Mod/Fem/femtest/data/calculix/ccx_cantilever_faceload.inp. No .FCStd for it in FreeCAD/Examples.

expected.vonMises: Not documented on the wiki page or in the example. Beam theory gives 432 MPa bending stress at the root (M c / I = 9e6 * 8000 * 500 / 8.333e10); the solve reads higher at the rigid hold's corners. Treat 400 to 800 MPa as the plausible band, not an answer key.
expected.replyNote: displacementMax.mm is the largest size of the displacement vector, so the bending case reads a little over the wiki's z figure (about 8 mm of x at the top and bottom fibres adds in quadrature): 86 to 90 mm

notCovered: fea_frame: not in this repo (no code in agentlink/; tests/test_no_addon_names.py lists it as an add-on's tool). Skipped as told.

fea_solve { nonlinear: true }, fea_hold kinds slide / pin / move, fea_load pressure / temperature / spin: reachable on this model but left out to keep the run short; each sends the solve to Agent Link's own deck (solvedBy says why).
fea_parts is set up but not solved: the tied solve of 9 m of steel and PLA is not a tutorial case.
fea_native { solver: elmer, write / run }: needs ElmerGrid / ElmerSolver.
fem_mesh { action: netgen }: needs Netgen installed with FreeCAD's Python; on the Mac expect the unavailable refusal.
fem_linearize on a post pipeline (Fem::FemPostPipeline): needs a FreeCAD built with VTK post-processing and a pipeline in the analysis.
The object name of the analysis's Gmsh mesh is taken to be Mesh in the clear_groups call: if FreeCAD numbered it (Mesh001), use the label fem_add's reply or session_state shows.
